To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a constitutive activation (overactivation) of the PI3 kinase/Akt pathway, increasingly detected in some acute myeloid leukemias, is associated with resistance to arsenic; 2) the resistance is mediated by NF‐κB; 3) selective inhibitors of the PI 3 kinase/Akt survival pathway may reverse resistance to arsenic.
